knowledge_gaps: Candidate softmax is a reasonable provisional experiment, but the report does not justify prioritizing it over completing the starting idea’s protected-versus-uniform deletion control. Missing diagnoses prevent claims of diagnosis alignment.

The inherited control objective is unspecified: ordinary BCE and gBCE imply different comparisons. State its exact formula, positive weighting, negative reduction and K. Any common sampling changes require distinguishing the matched control from the unchanged baseline.

Loss normalization does not match gradient scale across BCE, gBCE and candidate softmax. Holding optimizer settings fixed is a valid initial comparison, but results would reflect both objective structure and optimization effects.

Reproduction still requires the baseline integration details: exact training-history exclusions, empty eligible-set handling, augmentation probability and positional treatment, branch schedule, validation cadence, checkpoint eligibility and tie-breaking. Implementation difficulty 3 understates this integration work; originality 3 and potential 6 are reasonable provisional judgments.

The report lacks a concrete remaining-compute allocation and uncertainty plan. Prespecify completed four-category comparisons and checkpoint opportunities; report category results, all attempts and paired uncertainty only when host-provided per-user outcomes exist. Repeated validation selection can overfit the fixed panel.

History-conditioned negative exclusions and duplicate candidates change the sampled objective. Training-derived item-frequency and history-length diagnostics should assess popularity shortcuts, without claiming full-catalog improvement or treating unobserved items as confirmed negatives.
